title: Frequency Authorisation Letter
description: Grants a broadcaster the right to operate on an assigned frequency with stated technical parameters.

format.subject: AUTHORISATION TO OPERATE ON [FREQUENCY] MHZ — [STATION NAME]
bodyOutline: Reference to the application and date received
Statement of authorisation with assigned frequency and location
Technical parameters: ERP, antenna height, polarisation
Conditions of authorisation and compliance obligations
Validity period and renewal terms

sample.subject: AUTHORISATION TO OPERATE ON 98.5 MHZ — KASAPA FM
body: We refer to your application dated 14th January, 2026 for authorisation to establish and operate an FM broadcasting station in the Greater Accra Region.

We write to inform you that the National Communications Authority (NCA) has approved your application and hereby authorises Kasapa Broadcasting Ltd. to operate on the frequency 98.5 MHz, Accra and its environs, with effect from the date of this letter.

The station shall operate with an Effective Radiated Power (ERP) not exceeding **2 kW**, antenna height above average terrain of **60 metres**, and vertical polarisation, as approved by the Authority.

This authorisation is subject to the general conditions of frequency authorisation issued by the Authority, and to strict compliance with the technical parameters stated above. Any variation must be approved in writing before implementation.
This authorisation is valid for a period of **five (5) years** from the date of this letter, and is renewable upon application not later than ninety (90) days before expiry.

title: Interference Resolution Notice
description: Directs an operator to remedy confirmed harmful interference within a stated period.

format.subject: NOTICE OF HARMFUL INTERFERENCE ON [FREQUENCY] MHZ
bodyOutline: Description of the interference observed, with dates and measurements
Reference to the monitoring evidence (incident number)
Regulatory basis for the direction
Required remedial action and deadline (typically 14 days)
Consequences of non-compliance

sample.subject: NOTICE OF HARMFUL INTERFERENCE ON 1842.5 MHZ
body: Monitoring conducted by the Broadcast Monitoring Centre on 12th and 13th February, 2026 detected harmful interference on the frequency 1842.5 MHz, affecting mobile network services in the Tema industrial area.

This is with reference to incident **BMC-INT-2026-031** logged by our monitoring officers, in which the interfering emission was traced to equipment operating from your base station facility at Tema Community 4.
By this notice, you are directed to identify and remedy the source of the interference within **fourteen (14) days** from the date of this letter.
Failure to comply within the stated period may result in enforcement action under the Electronic Communications Act, 2008 (Act 775), including suspension of the affected equipment's authorisation.

title: ISP Registration Confirmation
description: Confirms registration of a new Internet Service Provider and states the licence conditions.

format.subject: CONFIRMATION OF REGISTRATION — [OPERATOR NAME]
bodyOutline: Reference to the application and evaluation outcome
Registration number and effective date
Class of licence and authorised services
Fees, reporting obligations and QoS requirements
Conditions attached to the registration

sample.subject: CONFIRMATION OF REGISTRATION — SAVANNAH WIRELESS LTD.
body: We refer to your application dated 19th January, 2026 for registration as an Internet Service Provider, and the subsequent evaluation of your technical and business proposal by this Authority.
We are pleased to inform you that your application has been approved. Savannah Wireless Ltd. is hereby registered under registration number **NCA/ISP/2026/056**, effective the date of this letter.
Your registration is a Class II Internet Service Provider licence, authorising the provision of fixed wireless broadband services within the Northern, North East and Savannah Regions.

You are required to pay the prescribed annual regulatory fee, submit quarterly subscriber and quality-of-service reports, and comply with all conditions set out in the attached schedule of licence conditions.

title: Earth Station Licence Offer
description: Offers an earth station licence subject to coordination conditions and payment of fees.

format.subject: OFFER OF EARTH STATION LICENCE — [SITE NAME]
bodyOutline: Reference to the application and coordination outcome
Licensed frequencies, satellite, and orbital slot
Coordination conditions and power limits
Applicable fees and acceptance deadline
Validity and renewal terms

sample.subject: OFFER OF EARTH STATION LICENCE — SKYLINK TELEPORT, PRAMPRAM
body: We refer to your application dated 5th December, 2025 for an earth station licence to operate a satellite ground station at Prampram, and to the coordination report subsequently issued by this Authority.

We are pleased to offer you a licence to operate an earth station at the above location, on the frequencies **6425–6725 MHz (uplink)** and **3625–3925 MHz (downlink)**, coordinated with **NSS-12 at 57°E**.

This offer is subject to the coordination conditions and power limits set out in the attached annex, and to payment of the prescribed licence fee within **thirty (30) days** of the date of this letter.
This licence, once accepted, shall be valid for a period of **ten (10) years**, renewable in accordance with the Authority's licensing guidelines.

title: Outage Explanation Request
description: Requests a formal explanation from an operator following a significant service outage.

format.subject: REQUEST FOR EXPLANATION — SERVICE OUTAGE OF [DATE]
bodyOutline: Description of the outage as observed or reported
Regulatory basis for the request
Information required: root cause, duration, affected subscribers, remediation
Response deadline (typically 7 working days)

sample.subject: REQUEST FOR EXPLANATION — SERVICE OUTAGE OF 4TH MARCH, 2026
body: The Authority received multiple subscriber complaints of a network outage affecting voice and data services in the Kumasi metropolis on 4th March, 2026, between approximately **09:00 and 14:30 GMT**.

Pursuant to your quality-of-service obligations under your operating licence, you are required to submit a written explanation addressing the root cause of the outage, its duration, the number of subscribers affected, and the remedial measures taken or proposed.
Your response should reach this office not later than **seven (7) working days** from the date of this letter.

title: Compliance Inspection Notification
description: Notifies a station of a scheduled technical compliance inspection.

format.subject: NOTIFICATION OF TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE INSPECTION
bodyOutline: Inspection window and scope
Records and access to be made available
Names of the inspection team
Contact for rescheduling requests

sample.subject: NOTIFICATION OF TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE INSPECTION
body: This is to notify you that officials of the National Communications Authority will conduct a routine technical compliance inspection of your broadcasting facilities on 17th March, 2026, between **10:00 and 13:00 GMT**.
The inspection will cover verification of transmitter power, frequency accuracy, antenna system integrity, and general compliance with the technical parameters stated in your authorisation.

Kindly ensure that station records, including the equipment logbook and previous inspection reports, are made available to the inspection team, and that a technically competent staff member is present throughout the visit.

The inspection team will comprise **Ing. Kofi Asante-Frimpong** and one Engineering Officer from the Broadcasting Services Division. Any request to reschedule should be directed to this office at least three (3) working days in advance.

title: Extension of Time to Commence Operations
description: Grants a licensed broadcaster additional time to commence transmission, typically subject to payment of a penalty fee.

format.subject: REQUEST FOR EXTENSION OF TIME TO START OPERATIONS
bodyOutline: Acknowledgement of the request and date received
Approval of the extension with the new commencement deadline
Penalty payable and reference to the attached invoice
Deadline to settle penalty and outstanding regulatory fees
Requirement to invite the Authority for a pre-commissioning inspection

sample.subject: REQUEST FOR EXTENSION OF TIME TO START OPERATIONS
body: We acknowledge your letter dated 6th May, 2024 on the above subject requesting for extension of time to commence operations of the FM Broadcasting Radio Station.

Please be informed that the National Communications Authority (NCA) has favourably considered your request for extension to commence operations by 22nd May, 2025 subject to payment of penalty of **Three Thousand Ghana Cedis (GH₵3,000.00)** per the attached invoice numbered **14234**.

Life Radio Ghana Limited is therefore required to pay the said penalty and settle the Annual Spectrum and Regulatory fee within thirty (30) days from the date of this letter, i.e. **on or before 21st June 2024.**
Life Radio Ghana Limited is requested to invite officials of the NCA for inspection of your broadcasting facilities before commencement of operations.
Please take note and be guided accordingly.
